inspiration.observed_pattern: An UPDATE selects keys through an IN subquery whose nested correlated COUNT is grouped and thresholded.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one qualifying account with two subscriptions and one nonqualifying account with one subscription while retaining the nested correlated aggregate and final ordered state.

fixture_notes: Only account 901 has more than one subscription and must increase from 40 to 65.
determinism_notes: Two fixed accounts and three fixed subscriptions produce one deterministic update. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE support_accounts_min (account_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE account_subscriptions_min (subscription_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, plan_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE support_accounts_min AS a SET score = score + 25 WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT s.account_id FROM account_subscriptions_min AS s WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_subscriptions_min AS nested_s WHERE nested_s.account_id = s.account_id GROUP BY nested_s.account_id) > 1 GROUP BY s.account_id)

checks.sql: SELECT account_id, account_label, score FROM support_accounts_min ORDER BY account_id
